categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
